'''Football Club Nordsjælland''', commonly known as '''FC Nordsjælland''', '''Nordsjælland''' ({{IPA|da|ˈnoɐ̯ɕeˌlænˀ}}) or '''FCN''', is a professional  [[Football club (association football)|football club]] from the Danish town of [[Farum]]. Founded as ''Farum Boldklub'' from the merger of the town's two football clubs Farum IK and Stavnsholt BK in 1991, the club changed its name to FC Nordsjælland in 2003.<ref name = "nord"/> In international competitions, the club can be transliterated as '''Nordsjaelland'''.

FCN plays in the [[Danish Superliga]], winning its first medal in the [[2002–03 Danish Superliga|2002–03 season]], taking third place. Since then, the ''Wild Tigers'' have made four appearances in Europe under both the old [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] format in [[2003–04 UEFA Cup|2003–04]], [[2008–09 UEFA Cup|2008–09]] and in the UEFA Europa League during the [[2010–11 UEFA Europa League|2010–11]] and [[2011–12 UEFA Europa League|2011–12]] seasons. In [[2009–10 Danish Cup|2010]], the club won its first [[Danish Cup]]<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.kickoff.com/news/15394/sibusiso-zuma-lifts-danish-cup-with-fc-nordsjaelland.php |title=Sibusiso Zuma lifts Danish Cup with Fc Nordsjaelland |publisher=KickOff.com |date=14 May 2010 |access-date=10 August 2011 |archive-date=28 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180828102425/http://www.kickoff.com/news/15394/sibusiso-zuma-lifts-danish-cup-with-fc-nordsjaelland.php |url-status=dead }}</ref> and successfully defended it the following year in [[2010–11 Danish Cup|2011]], beating [[FC Midtjylland|Midtjylland]] in both finals.<ref name = "nord"/><ref>{{cite web |last=Bruun |first=Peter |url=http://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/association=den/news/newsid=1637648.html |title=Season review: Denmark |publisher=UEFA |date=2 June 2011 |access-date=10 August 2011 |archive-date=28 August 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180828203228/https://www.uefa.com/memberassociations/association=den/news/newsid=1637648.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> FCN won the [[2011–12 Danish Superliga]] in May 2012 which qualified the team to participate in the [[2012–13 UEFA Champions League]].

Nordsjælland plays its home matches at [[Right to Dream Park]], which has a capacity of 9,200 spectators.<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 June 2025 |title=Ændret kapacitet på Right to Dream Park |url=https://fcn.dk/nyheder/2025/juni/aendret-kapacitet-pa-right-to-dream-park |access-date=28 July 2025 |website=fcn.dk |language=da}}</ref>"}}
